description: The canonical six-overlay diagnostic layer system for TriadicFrameworks. Applies six overlays sequentially — Structural → Drift → Coherence → Substrate → Dimensional → Domain — to any system under Triadic analysis. Produces the Domain Diagnostic Report (DDR), Domain Action Map (DAM), and Cross-Domain Causality Summary (CDCS). Coordinates all 11 RTT engines, 16 modules, and 27 UI overlay panels.
role: Pack coordinator — orchestrates the six-overlay diagnostic sequence; canonical entry point for all S3 Spine runs
purpose: Six-overlay canonical diagnostic layer system: Structural → Drift → Coherence → Substrate → Dimensional → Domain; produces DDR, DAM, CDCS; coordinates all RTT engines and UI overlays
